I sat down with Shannon Jean (  @businessbrainshow   ) and we dove deep into how anyone can start reselling with zero dollars. Shannon showed me live auctions and walked me through a complete roadmap from flipping free Facebook couches to building a full reselling business that makes over $100K. We talked about how to find your unfair advantage, research what sells before buying, and spot the “boring” products that everyone else overlooks — like rugs, books, and parking meters. Shannon also shared stories of real people turning $1 into thousands, from a weatherman making $40K flipping couches to a seller doing $17K a month in pressure washers. Whether you want to make side income or build a full business, this episode shows exactly how to start.
